Backed by a US$10M seed round led by Playground Global. This is an industrial deep-tech company with no public API or developer platform; the profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: Iluka Resources
providers.description: Iluka Resources Limited (ASX:ILU) is an Australian-listed global critical minerals company with expertise in exploration, mining, processing, marketing and rehabilitation. It produces mineral sands products - zircon, rutile, synthetic rutile and ilmenite - with mining and processing operations in South Australia, Western Australia and New South Wales, and is developing a fully integrated rare earths refinery at Eneabba, Western Australia. Its public website covers operations, products, investor relations and sustainability; no public developer API was observed during identity profiling.

providers.name: Capricorn Metals
providers.description: Capricorn Metals Ltd (ASX: CMM) is an Australian gold producer headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It operates two project areas in Western Australia: the Karlawinda Gold Project, 65 km south-east of Newman in the Pilbara and in production since June 2021, and the Mt Gibson Gold Project, with a combined stated resource base of 6.6 million ounces and reserves of 4.0 million ounces. The company publishes no public API, developer portal or developer documentation; its website (capmetals.com.au) covers corporate, investor, sustainability and project information.

providers.name: Kaiser Aluminum
providers.description: Kaiser Aluminum manufactures semi-fabricated aluminum products for industrial applications across aerospace, packaging, general engineering, and automotive markets. The nearly century-old company delivers highly engineered aluminum products focused on strength, weight efficiency, and sustainability. Kaiser Online serves as a customer portal for quotes, order tracking, depot stock searches, and material certifications.

providers.name: Skycatch
providers.description: Skycatch built spatial data capture, processing, and analytics for mining and construction sites, turning drone and aerial imagery into high-precision 3D data, volumetrics, and AI-driven site insights. Its products included Spatial Sight, Spatial DataHub (datahub.skycatch.com), and EdgeServer for on-site edge processing. Skycatch was acquired by Caterpillar Inc. on July 7, 2026 (following Caterpillar's RPMGlobal acquisition) to expand its mining technology capabilities. A developer platform exists at docs.skycatch.com but is password-gated, and no public API specification is available. Originally surfaced as a GV (Google Ventures) portfolio company.

providers.name: Barrick Mining
providers.description: Barrick Mining Corporation is a leading global gold and copper mining company, operating mines and projects across the Americas, Africa, and the Middle East. The company focuses on sustainable mining practices, community development, and delivering value to shareholders. Its website provides extensive information on operations, governance, sustainability initiatives, investor relations, and career opportunities.

providers.name: Cowin
providers.description: Cowin & Company, Inc. is a Birmingham‑based mining construction firm founded in 1924, offering a wide range of underground and surface mining services such as highwall stabilization, aggregate mining, tunnel construction, and shotcrete. With over a century of experience, the company emphasizes safety, skilled personnel, and custom engineering solutions for clients across the United States.

providers.name: Deep Yellow
providers.description: Deep Yellow Limited is an Australian uranium company listed on the ASX (DYL), with secondary listings on the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSX: DYL) and OTC Markets (DYLLF), describing its aim as becoming a tier-one, low-cost uranium producer. Its portfolio includes the Tumas and Omahola projects and the Nova and Yellow Dune joint ventures in Namibia, plus the Mulga Rock project in Western Australia and the Alligator River project and Cooper Creek JV in the Northern Territory. Its site (deepyellow.com.au) is a corporate and investor-relations site; no public developer portal, API documentation or API product was found on it. The company was surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026).

providers.name: Marianaminerals
providers.description: Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated critical-minerals company supplying the metals essential to modern energy, artificial intelligence, and defense technologies. The company currently develops copper and lithium production projects, with plans spanning cobalt, aluminum, graphite, uranium, and rare earth metals, and is headquartered in San Francisco with an engineering office in Houston. Backed by Khosla Ventures, it was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; an enrichment pass found no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Nucor
providers.description: Nucor Corporation is a Fortune 500 American steel and steel products manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is the largest steel producer in the United States and the largest recycler of any material in North America. Nucor does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this index captures the corporate, sustainability, and certification resources that are publicly available.

providers.name: Atomionics
providers.description: Atomionics is a Singapore-based deep-technology company, founded in 2018, that builds quantum sensors for mineral resource exploration and GPS-free navigation. Its Gravio quantum-grade gravity-sensing platform uses cold-atom interferometry to measure tiny gravitational changes and map the Earth's subsurface at high resolution, and its ORE-O AI geologist visualizes complex geologies and mineral deposits in 3D to accelerate exploration for energy-transition resources such as copper, lithium, nickel, graphite and rare earth elements. The company does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile tracks its identity and public web surface within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BANIQL
providers.description: BANIQL CORP. (BANiQL) is developing a sustainable process for selectively extracting nickel and cobalt for use in lithium-ion battery production. Its core technology uses a chemical process to selectively extract nickel and cobalt from raw materials at lower temperatures and atmospheric pressure, producing high-quality nickel at roughly 30% lower cost than High Pressure Acid Leaching (HPAL) with net-zero waste, cutting energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions by around 80% while repurposing leftover materials into products like fertilizers and construction materials. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network; this materials/cleantech company publishes no developer or API surface, so this profile carries company identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: Phoenix Tailings
providers.description: Phoenix Tailings is a clean rare earth and critical minerals refining company working to restore U.S. industrial independence by building domestic refining capacity for the metals behind every major technology. It recovers rare earth elements and other critical minerals from mining waste (tailings) and low-grade feedstocks using a low-emission, zero-landfill process, supplying materials for medical devices, electric vehicles and automotive systems, electronics, and defense applications. The company operates as a materials producer and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this API Evangelist profile tracks its identity and web/domain security posture.

providers.name: Linear Labs
providers.description: Linear Labs is an industrial motor technology company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, building high-torque motor systems for wind, nuclear, pumps, actuators, mining, and defense applications. Its patented Hunstable Electric Turbine (HET) permanent-magnet architecture uses a circumferential flux design the company states delivers 2x torque density, 97% peak efficiency, and 50% weight reduction versus conventional motors, scaling from 10 kW to 2.2 MW. Its PitchPro 2000 is a complete pitch-system replacement for aging GE 1.5 wind turbines, pairing the HET motor with KEBA drive electronics, a Bachmann PLC controller, and ultracapacitor backup power. Linear Labs is a hardware manufacturer and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable technical surface; this profile is maintained for network coverage and identity only.

providers.name: Emerald Resources
providers.description: Emerald Resources NL is an international gold exploration and mining company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX:EMR), describing itself as a sustainable, multi-asset gold producer in the making. Its website covers its Cambodia and Australia gold projects, exploration, mineral resources and reserves, sustainability programs, and investor material such as ASX announcements, reports and presentations. The company publishes no developer portal or public API documentation; its corporate site runs on WordPress.

providers.name: Coinmine
providers.description: Coinmine is a consumer cryptocurrency-mining hardware company known for the Coinmine One, a plug-and-play home mining device that let non-technical owners mine and hold crypto assets from a simple companion app. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the coinmine.com storefront is offline (the Shopify store returns "unavailable"), so no live developer portal, API, or documentation surface could be confirmed. The registrable domain remains active for email (SPF/DMARC configured), and this profile captures the honest, probed security posture of that domain.

providers.name: Epiroc
providers.description: Epiroc AB is a leading global provider of equipment and services for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. The company designs, manufactures and supports a broad range of products including drilling rigs, rock excavation tools, and automation solutions that improve productivity and safety in challenging environments. Epiroc focuses on sustainable development and innovation, delivering advanced technology to customers worldwide.

providers.name: Freeport-McMoRan
providers.description: Freeport-McMoRan is a leading international mining company with headquarters in Phoenix, Arizona, operating large, long-lived geographically diverse assets with significant proven and probable reserves of copper, gold, and molybdenum.

providers.name: GMR
providers.description: GMR (General Mining Research) is a crypto and Web3 company backed by Multicoin Capital and tracked in the API Evangelist network. Its public presence is a single-page web application at gmr.xyz identifying it as "General Mining Research" with a general contact at info@gmr.xyz. As of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, well-known discovery surface, or SDK/CLI could be found — the only machine-verifiable signal is the domain's TLS/DNS security posture. This profile remains a lead awaiting a published API or developer surface to enrich further.

providers.name: Ideon Technologies
providers.description: Ideon Technologies (ideon.ai) develops REVEAL, a subsurface intelligence platform that uses muon tomography and geophysical inversion to image, map, and monitor mineral deposits and geological structures deep underground. It helps mining companies reduce geologic uncertainty across exploration, resource evaluation, geotechnical analysis, and cave monitoring, with customers including Rio Tinto, Vale, Glencore, and BHP. The company is backed by Playground Global. Ideon publishes a marketing and content web presence (solutions, case studies, papers, blog, careers) but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

providers.name: VerAI
providers.description: VerAI Discoveries is an AI-driven mineral discovery company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Its proprietary AI/ML Discovery Platform searches magnetic, gravimetric, electromagnetic, and seismic geophysical datasets to detect concealed mineral deposits in underexplored covered terrain, generating drill-ready targets across a portfolio of more than sixty mineral projects and royalties in North and South America. VerAI partners with explorers and investors to develop critical-mineral assets essential to the green-energy transition. The company is backed by Insight Partners, Blumberg Capital, Chrysalix Venture Capital, and Orion Industrial Ventures, and to date exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Optimotive
providers.description: Optimotive is an autonomous-robotics company building a vertically integrated fleet of advanced robots for the toughest, most extreme environments across construction, mining, and oil and gas. Its robots take on the mundane, repetitive, and hazardous tasks that burden human workers, doing it cost-effectively. Two products are already deployed with major market players: IRIS, a wheeled autonomous robot that captures large-scale site data, and BOX, which provides a reliable home base and on-site infrastructure for entirely self-sufficient robots. Two more robots are joining the fleet: MULE for onsite material handling and SCRUBBLES for site cleanup. The company is vertically integrated from developing its own AI to 3D printing its robots, owning the full hardware and software stack. Founded by CEO Scott Fairley and based in Windsor, Ontario, Canada, Optimotive raised a 2M USD seed round led by Version One Ventures in September 2024, with participation from Garage and NewLab. As a physical robotics hardware business, Optimotive publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK at this time.

providers.name: Peabody Energy
providers.description: Peabody Energy is the world's largest private-sector coal company, mining and supplying coal to electricity generators and steel producers in the United States and around the world. No public developer APIs are currently documented for this organization.

providers.name: Lynas Rare Earths
providers.description: Lynas Rare Earths Limited (ASX: LYC; formerly Lynas Corporation Limited, renamed November 2020) is a Perth-headquartered miner and processor of rare earths and the largest rare-earth producer outside China. It mines the Mount Weld deposit in Western Australia and operates processing facilities in Kalgoorlie and at Gebeng, Malaysia, producing separated rare-earth materials including NdPr and the heavy rare earths dysprosium and terbium. Surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026); no public developer API is known.

providers.name: PLS Group
providers.description: PLS Group Limited (ASX: PLS), formerly Pilbara Minerals, is a West Perth, Western Australia based producer of lithium materials for the battery supply chain, founded in 2005. Its principal asset is the Pilgangoora lithium operation in the Pilbara region, and it holds a portfolio of lithium assets and downstream strategic partnerships. The company was surfaced via the Apidays Australia 2026 harvest; its website pls.com refuses automated readers with an HTTP 403 bot challenge, and no public API, developer portal or documentation has been identified.

providers.name: South32
providers.description: South32 is a globally diversified mining and metals company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia, spun out of BHP Billiton in May 2015 and listed on the ASX (S32). It produces commodities including alumina, aluminium, copper, manganese, silver, lead and zinc. It was surfaced via the API Evangelist harvest backlog (australia-apidays-2026); no public developer program or API has been identified, and its website (south32.net) answered our crawler with an HTTP 403 bot challenge.

providers.name: Vault Minerals
providers.description: Vault Minerals is a Perth, Western Australia-based intermediate gold producer. Its own site says the company is a financially disciplined, returns-focused gold business anchored by a long-life asset in the Leonora district. It runs the Leonora Operations, the Mount Monger Gold Operations near Kalgoorlie and the Deflector Gold-Copper Operations in the Midwest Region of Western Australia, along with the Sugar Zone Gold Project in Ontario, Canada. The site publishes investor announcements, presentations, reports and Genesis Scheme of Arrangement information. It does not publish a developer portal, API documentation or a public API.

providers.name: Terra AI
providers.description: Terra AI is a geoscience frontier company building specialized artificial intelligence for the natural resources sector, focused on subsurface characterization and exploration optimization for mining and reservoir operators. Its platform integrates exploration data to generate large populations of geological models, helping teams decide where to drill, characterize deposits, and assess project economics earlier — the company cites 50-60% fewer drilling meters and 2-3x more precise resource estimates versus conventional methods. Terra AI raised a $20M Series A led by Khosla Ventures with BHP Ventures in June 2026 and serves copper, gold, rare-earth (REE), and reservoir projects. The company operates on a B2B model and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Joy Global (Komatsu Mining)
providers.description: Joy Global was a worldwide leader in manufacturing, servicing, and distributing equipment for surface mining, underground mining, and rock excavation before being acquired by Komatsu and rebranded as Komatsu Mining. There is no public developer program or APIs published for Joy Global / Komatsu Mining at this time.

providers.name: Ametrine
providers.description: Ametrine is a mining and metals company based in the Oriente region, specializing in the extraction and processing of gemstones, particularly the rare mineral ametrine. Established in 1990, the family-owned business focuses on sustainable, non‑destructive mining practices and offers a range of mineral products online. The company provides APIs for product data, mining operations, and corporate information to integrate with partners and developers.

providers.name: Mine Health and Safety Administration
providers.description: The Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) works to prevent mining related deaths, injuries, and illnesses through mine regulations, inspections, and training programs.

providers.name: Newmont
providers.description: Newmont Corporation is the world's leading gold company and a producer of copper, silver, zinc, and lead, with operations and projects across the Americas, Africa, Australia, and Papua New Guinea.

providers.name: Alpha Metallurgical Resources
providers.description: Profile for Alpha Metallurgical Resources in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 925).

providers.name: Arch Resources
providers.description: Profile for Arch Resources in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 922).

providers.name: Cloud Peak Energy
providers.description: Cloud Peak Energy Inc. was an American coal mining company headquartered in Gillette, Wyoming, established in 2009 as a spin-off from Rio Tinto Energy America. The company operated three open-pit mines in the Powder River Basin (Wyoming and Montana) and held a 50% interest in the Decker Coal Company. Cloud Peak Energy filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in May 2019 amid declining demand for Powder River coal in East Asian and US markets and is no longer operating. This profile is maintained as a historical record - Cloud Peak Energy did not publish public APIs.

providers.name: Descartes Labs
providers.description: Descartes Labs was a Santa Fe, New Mexico geospatial intelligence company founded in 2014 as a spin-out from Los Alamos National Laboratory. The company built the Descartes Labs Platform, a cloud-native geospatial data refinery and analytics environment combining a petabyte-scale satellite imagery archive (Landsat, Sentinel-1/2, MODIS, NAIP, PlanetScope, SkySat, commercial radar, NEXRAD weather radar, plus client-uploaded data) with a Python client library, JupyterHub-based workbench, and distributed compute for training and running deep learning and remote-sensing models at scale. Customers in agriculture, mining, energy, defense, insurance, and the U.S. government used the platform to build production geospatial machine learning pipelines covering crop forecasting, mineral exploration, infrastructure monitoring, methane detection, wildfire response, and ESG reporting. The Platform exposed a Catalog (imagery, bands, products, blobs, events), a Compute service (containerised functions, jobs, schedules), a Vector service (tabular and geospatial features), Dynamic Compute (lazy raster algebra and tiling), Auth, and a `descarteslabs` CLI. In October 2024, EarthDaily Analytics — backed by Antarctica Capital — acquired Descartes Labs and the Descartes Labs Government, Inc. subsidiary, folding the team, customers, and platform into the EarthDaily Constellation programme. The product was rebranded EarthOne in 2025; the `descarteslabs` Python package has been formally discontinued in favour of `earthdaily-earthone` (v5.x), the github.com/descarteslabs organisation has been renamed to `dlarchives`, www.descarteslabs.com is now a parked domain, and the docs.descarteslabs.com developer portal has been retired in favour of EarthDaily-hosted EarthOne documentation. This catalog entry preserves the historical Descartes Labs Platform surface as an archive — see the EarthDaily / EarthOne profile for the active product.

providers.name: Kespry
providers.description: Kespry was an industrial drone and aerial-intelligence company founded in the San Francisco Bay Area that paired automated fixed-perimeter drones with a cloud analytics platform to turn aerial imagery into measurable data. Its product was used for stockpile and inventory volumetrics in mining and aggregates, construction-site progress monitoring and earthworks, and insurance roof inspection. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Kespry was acquired by Firmatek in 2020 and the brand has since been retired; the former developer and marketing domain kespry.com now issues a 301 redirect to firmatek.com. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network for lineage and portfolio mapping, but Kespry publishes no live, standalone developer surface, API, documentation, or client SDKs of its own.
